item.description:
Pluck 1.0 is here.

Pluck lives in your notch and makes the screenshot you just took easy to use, then gets it out of your way.

In this first release:

  • Every screenshot appears in the notch, ready to copy, mark up, pin, or drag into any app
  • Hover the notch to peek at recent screenshots, or click it to open the Shelf and see them all
  • Old screenshots move to the Trash on your schedule, and pinned ones are always kept
  • Pluck only touches real screenshots, asks for one permission, and nothing leaves your Mac
